test_title: PYST 73: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 28 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are seated in a straight line and all of them are facing north, but not necessarily in the same order. B sits second to right of F. F sits at one of the extreme ends of the line. Only three people sit between B and E. C sits third to the left of D. Only two people sit between D and A. G is not an immediate neighbour of E. Who is sitting on the immediate left of H?
solution:
Given: Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H.

1. F sits at one of the extreme ends of the line.

2. Only three people sit between B and E.

3. C sits third to the left of D.

4. Only two people sit between D and A.

5. G is not an immediate neighbour of E.

6. B sits second to right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec5da84c12e2627f255d0d8e298bac1a098dcc1163db0aaadcd67718e90df4d1.png] 

So, **D** is sitting on the immediate left of H.

Hence, the correct answer is** "D".**
